invariants.rationale: The method is an instance method and accesses object state via 'this', requiring it to be non-null.
The method assigns getChildren() to 'children' and immediately accesses its 'size' field, so getChildren() must not be null.
'size' is typically non-negative for lists/arrays; SnapshotArray implementation also expects non-negative size.
Padding fields are usually non-negative values controlling layout.
Spacing parameters generally are non-negative in UI layout code.
